pages.title: search_sounds
pages.html:
Find sounds in the user's local audio Libraries from a free-text description in any language (or sounds similar to a known asset). Omit libraryId to search every Library at once. Each result gives the absolute path of the original file, duration, tags, categories, a 0-100 score per model and, for long recordings, the matching time segment: enough to propose sounds to the user. Each model retrieves from its own index; ranks are fused with weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion. The job is asynchronous: poll cy_get_job and read outputs.results when Completed.

database = open_database(library) roots = [r for r in library.roots if not parameters.get('rootId') or r['rootId'] == parameters['rootId']] if parameters.get('rootId') and not roots: raise CyToolError('NotFound', 'Unknown rootId: '+parameters['rootId']) trees = folder_tree(database, [r['rootId'] for r in roots]) prefix, depth = str(parameters.get('folderPrefix') or ''), parameters.get('maxDepth', 2) out = [] for root in roots: tree = trees.get(root['rootId'], {'files': 0, 'direct': 0, 'children': {}}) folders = flatten_folders(tree, prefix, None if depth == 0 else depth) out.append({'rootId': root['rootId'], 'rootPath': root['path'], 'enabled': root['enabled'], 'files': tree['files'], 'directFiles': tree['direct'], 'folders': folders}) return {'roots': out, 'folderPrefix': prefix, 'maxDepth': depth, 'hint': 'Process one folder with filters {"rootIds": [rootId], "folderPrefix": path} in browse_assets or update_assets.'} # -- search ------------------------------------------------------------------ def op_search_sounds(context, parameters): if parameters.get('libraryId'): targets = [get_library(parameters['libraryId'])] else: # an AI client that only wants "a sound of X" does not need to know the Libraries first if parameters.get('similarTo'): raise CyToolError('InvalidParameters', 'similarTo needs the libraryId of that asset') targets = list_libraries() if not targets: raise CyToolError('NotFound', 'No Library exists yet', recoverable=True, suggested_action='Create one with create_library, then scan_library and analyze_library') selection = None if parameters.get('selectionStart') is not None or parameters.get('selectionEnd') is not None: if not parameters.get('similarTo'): raise CyToolError('InvalidParameters', 'A selection needs similarTo') selection = (parameters.get('selectionStart', 0.0), parameters.get('selectionEnd', 0.0)) if selection[1]-selection[0] < 0.05: raise CyToolError('InvalidParameters', 'Selection is shorter than 50 ms') if parameters.get('text') and parameters.get('similarTo'): raise CyToolError('InvalidParameters', 'Use either text or similarTo') context.progress(5, currentStep='Understanding the query') result, skipped, understood = None, [], None for library in targets: try: found = searching.search(library, open_database(library), pool, registry.load_registry(), text=parameters.get('text', ''), similar_to=parameters.get('similarTo', ''), selection=selection, models=parameters.get('models'), filters=visible_filters(library, parameters.get('filters')), top_k=parameters.get('topK', 50), llm_mode=parameters.get('llmAssist', 'auto'), llm_model=parameters.get('llmModel', ''), weights=parameters.get('weights'), rrf_k=parameters.get('rrfK', 60), device=parameters.get('device'), cancelled=cancelled(context), understood=understood) except CyToolError as exc: if len(targets) > 1 and exc.code in ('NotAnalyzed', 'InvalidState'): # a Library that is not indexed yet must not hide the others skipped.append({'libraryId': library.id, 'name': library.name, 'reason': exc.code+': '+exc.message}); continue raise understood = (found['query']['structured'], found['query']['llm']) if found['mode'] == 'text' else None for item in found['results']: item.update(libraryId=library.id, libraryName=library.name) found['libraries'] = [{'libraryId': library.id, 'name': library.name, 'candidates': found['total']}] if result is None: result = found else: result['results'] += found['results']; result['total'] += found['total']; result['libraries'] += found['libraries'] result['models'] += found['models']; result['seconds'] = round(result['seconds']+found['seconds'], 3) if result is None: raise CyToolError('NotAnalyzed', 'No Library has embeddings yet: '+'; '.join(s['name']+' ('+s['reason']+')' for s in skipped), recoverable=True, suggested_action='Run analyze_library on a Library, then search again') if len(result['libraries']) > 1: # each Library was ranked by its own fusion; the normalised fusion score is comparable across them result['results'].sort(key=lambda item: (-item['rrfNormalized'], -item['finalScore'])) result['results'] = result['results'][:parameters.get('topK', 50)] result['skippedLibraries'] = skipped path = context.path('outputs/search-results.json') path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding='utf-8') result['file'] = str(path) return result def op_understand_query(context, parameters): structured, info = llm.understand(pool, registry.load_registry(), parameters['text'].strip(), parameters.get('llmAssist', 'always'), parameters.get('llmModel', ''), parameters.get('device'), cancelled(context)) return {'structured': structured, 'llm': info} def op_categorize_library(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) reg = registry.load_registry() reports = [] models = searching.resolve_models(library, reg, parameters.get('models'), ('AudioEmbedding', 'TextEmbedding')) for index, descriptor in enumerate(models): reports.append(taxonomy.categorize(library, database, pool, descriptor, None, parameters.get('device'), cancelled(context), lambda p, index=index: context.progress((index+p/100)*100/len(models), currentStep='Categorizing with '+descriptor['displayName']))) context.cancellation.check() return {'models': reports} def op_find_duplicates(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) if parameters.get('mode', 'exact') == 'exact': groups = scanner.find_exact_duplicates(database, cancelled(context)) result = {'mode': 'exact', 'groups': groups} else: result = {'mode': 'probable', **analysis.probable_duplicates(library, database, registry.load_registry(), parameters.get('model'), parameters.get('threshold', 0.985), cancelled=cancelled(context))} rows = database.query("SELECT duplicate_group, audio_id, absolute_path, file_size FROM assets WHERE duplicate_group IS NOT NULL AND status='present' ORDER BY duplicate_group") listing = {} for row in rows: listing.setdefault(row['duplicate_group'], []).append({'audioId': row['audio_id'], 'path': row['absolute_path'], 'fileSize': row['file_size']}) result['duplicates'] = [{'group': key, 'kind': 'probable' if key.startswith('sim:') else 'exact', 'files': files} for key, files in list(listing.items())[:500]] return result def op_purge_missing(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) ids = [r['audio_id'] for r in database.query("SELECT audio_id FROM assets WHERE status='missing'")] with database.transaction(): scanner.forget_analysis(database, ids) for audio_id in ids: database.execute('DELETE FROM tags WHERE audio_id=?', (audio_id,)); database.execute('DELETE FROM asset_categories WHERE audio_id=?', (audio_id,)) database.execute('DELETE FROM assets WHERE audio_id=?', (audio_id,)) for audio_id in ids: try: waveform_path(library, audio_id).unlink() except OSError: pass return {'purged': len(ids)} # -- file tools: the only operations that change the original audio files ------------ def op_suggest_names(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) return fileops.suggest_names(library, database, parameters.get('audioIds'), parameters.get('onlyBadlyNamed', True), parameters.get('template', '{category}_{tags}'), parameters.get('maxTags', 3), parameters.get('limit', 500)) def op_rename_files(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) lock = exclusive(library) # never while a scan or an analysis reads these paths try: return fileops.rename_files(library, database, parameters['renames'], cancelled(context)) finally: lock.release() def op_undo_rename(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) lock = exclusive(library) try: return fileops.undo_rename(library, database) finally: lock.release() def op_write_metadata(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) lock = exclusive(library) try: return fileops.write_metadata(library, database, parameters['audioIds'], parameters.get('fields') or list(fileops.FIELDS), parameters.get('includeAutoTags', True), parameters.get('backup', True), cancelled(context), context.progress) finally: lock.release() # -- models --------------------------------------------------------------------- def op_list_models(context, parameters): reg = registry.load_registry() return {'models': [{**descriptor.public(), 'installation': installer.model_status(descriptor)} for descriptor in reg.values()], 'adapters': registry.BUILTIN_ADAPTERS, 'capabilities': list(registry.CAPABILITIES)} def op_install_model(context, parameters): configure_tls() descriptor = registry.get_model(parameters['modelKey']) return installer.install_model(descriptor, accept_license=parameters.get('acceptLicense', False), progress=context.progress, cancellation=context.cancellation, log=context.log, repair=parameters.get('repair', False)) def op_verify_model(context, parameters): return installer.verify_model(registry.get_model(parameters['modelKey']), context.cancellation, context.progress) def op_remove_model(context, parameters): descriptor = registry.get_model(parameters['modelKey']) for host in pool.hosts.values(): if descriptor.key in host.loaded: host.unload(descriptor.key) deleted = [] if parameters.get('deleteAnalysis'): for library in list_libraries(): database = open_database(library) for store in list_stores(library, database): if store['modelKey'] == descriptor.key: EmbeddingStore.open(library, database, store['analysisKey']).delete(); deleted.append({'libraryId': library.id, 'analysisKey': store['analysisKey']}) result = registry.unregister_custom(descriptor.key) if descriptor.custom else installer.remove_model(descriptor) return {**result, 'analysisDeleted': deleted, 'analysisKept': not parameters.get('deleteAnalysis')} def op_register_model(context, parameters): data = {k: v for k, v in parameters.items() if k not in ('licenseName', 'licenseUrl')} data['license'] = {'name': parameters.get('licenseName') or 'Not declared', 'url': parameters.get('licenseUrl', ''), 'requiresAcceptance': False} if 'AudioEmbedding' in data['capabilities'] and not data.get('embeddingDimension'): raise CyToolError('InvalidParameters', 'An embedding model needs embeddingDimension') descriptor = registry.register_custom(data, cancelled(context)) return {**descriptor.public(), 'installation': installer.model_status(descriptor)} def op_remove_model_data(context, parameters): library, database = opened(parameters) store = EmbeddingStore.open(library, database, parameters['analysisKey']) size = store.vectors_path.stat().st_size if store.vectors_path.is_file() else 0 store.delete() return {'analysisKey': parameters['analysisKey'], 'modelKey': store.model_key, 'freedBytes': size} def engine_report(): result = subprocess.run([runtime_python(), str(APP/'setup_backend.py'), '--status'], capture_output=True, text=True, creationflags=0x08000000 if os.name == 'nt' else 0, timeout=120) return json.loads(result.stdout) if result.returncode == 0 else {'installed': False, 'error': result.stderr[-500:]} def op_engine_status(context, parameters): return {'engine': engine_report(), 'workers': pool.status(), 'settings': settings()} def op_install_engine(context, parameters): command = [runtime_python(), str(APP/'setup_backend.py')]+(['--cpu-only'] if parameters.get('cpuOnly') else []) log_path = context.path('logs/install-engine.log') with log_path.open('w', encoding='utf-8') as handle: process = subprocess.Popen(command, stdout=handle, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, cwd=str(ROOT), creationflags=0x08000000 if os.name == 'nt' else 0) try: while process.poll() is None: context.cancellation.sleep(1.0) tail = log_path.read_text('utf-8', errors='replace')[-300:].strip().splitlines() context.progress(50, currentStep='Installing the AI engine', statusMessage=tail[-1][:200] if tail else '') except CyToolError: import psutil family = psutil.Process(process.pid).children(recursive=True)+[psutil.Process(process.pid)] for member in family: try: member.terminate() except psutil.NoSuchProcess: pass psutil.wait_procs(family, timeout=15) raise if process.returncode: raise CyToolError('InstallFailed', 'Engine installation failed', details=log_path.read_text('utf-8', errors='replace')[-3000:], recoverable=True) return {'engine': engine_report(), 'log': str(log_path)} def op_release_models(context, parameters): with runtime._cv: busy = [j for j in runtime._running if runtime._jobs[j]['operationId'] in ('analyze_library', 'search_sounds', 'categorize_library', 'understand_query')] if busy: raise CyToolError('Busy', 'A model job is running; cancel it or wait before releasing the models', recoverable=True) pool.stop() return {'workers': pool.status()} handlers = {name[3:]: function for name, function in locals().items() if name.startswith('op_')} estimated = {'analyze_library', 'search_sounds', 'categorize_library', 'understand_query'} for operation in runtime.descriptor['operations']: identifier = operation['id'] runtime.register(identifier, handlers[identifier], estimate=model_estimate if identifier in estimated else None) from cytools_core.shared_installation import register_operations register_operations(runtime, ROOT) return runtime if __name__ == '__main__': argv = sys.argv[1:] if '--data-dir' not in argv: argv = ['--data-dir', str(ROOT/'data/jobs'), *argv] raise SystemExit(run_cli(create_runtime, argv))
